songs.title: Take me to your heart
songs.lyrics:
Take me to your heart, take me to your soul
Give me your hand before I'm old
Show me what love is, haven't got a clue
Show me that wonders can be true

songs.title: My love
songs.lyrics:
An empty street, an empty house
A hole inside my heart
I'm all alone, the rooms are getting smaller

songs.title: Cry on my shoulder
songs.lyrics:
If the hero never comes to you
If the mountain never falls to the sea
If a dream that once came true
Can just slip away from you

songs.title: Breathless
songs.lyrics:
Go on, go on, leave me breathless
Come on, come on, leave me breathless
Go on, go on, leave me breathless
Come on, come on, leave me breathless

songs.title: Until You
songs.lyrics:
Until you I was lost and lonely
Until you, my life was cold
Until you, I was less than half a whole
Until you
